description_en: Creates a consumer account by the management party
description_zh: 管理方创建使用方账户
kebab_example: aliyun ltl create-member --biz-api-version 1.0.0 --biz-chain-id 4899730875490000 --member-uid 197203162343810000 --member-name '某公司' --member-contact '张三' --member-phone 13811110000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateMember

parameters.help_en: The API version number. Set the value to "1.0.0"
parameters.name: api_version

parameters.help_en: The UID of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user
parameters.name: member_uid

parameters.help_en:
The account name.
The name must be 2 to 30 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), periods (.), and parentheses (())
parameters.help_zh:
账户名称。
长度为2~30字符，可以包含中文、英文字母、数字、下划线（_）、横线（-）、英文句号（.）和圆括号（()）
parameters.name: member_name

parameters.help_en:
The account contact.
The value must be 2 to 30 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), periods (.), and parentheses (())
parameters.help_zh:
账户联系人。
长度为2~30字符，可以包含中文、英文字母、数字、下划线（_）、横线（-）、英文句号（.）和圆括号（()）
parameters.name: member_contact

parameters.help_en: The account phone number. The value can contain digits and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 账户电话。可包含数字和横线（-）
parameters.name: member_phone

parameters.help_en:
The remarks.
The value can be up to 100 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
备注信息。
长度限制为100字符
parameters.name: remark

Message.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
Message.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息
Message.example: The system is busy. Please try again later.

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful.
true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
